items.html: And behold, these thirty-two paths in the Hochma now are thirty-two Elokim, because the Mochin of nursing are Names of Elokim, as above. But the thirty-two paths of Gadlut are Havayot. And behold, it was explained above that the Mochin of the time of nursing are three Names of Elokim in their simple spelling, each of which has five letters — unlike in Gadlut, where the Daat is divided into two, as mentioned. And behold, just as there are three Mochin of Elokim in the Tzelem of Ima, so there are three Mochin, three Elokim, in the Tzelem of Aba.
